<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission scrutiny:</strong> Petitions have been filed in the Supreme Court seeking an expert committee led by a former CJI to investigate the Election Commission&#x27;s functioning amid rising concerns over institutional trust and the controversial SIR revision exercise.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>INDIA bloc protests:</strong> The INDIA bloc has announced a protest in Agartala on October 30 to demand the withdrawal of the SIR exercise and the removal of the Chief Election Commissioner, while the BJP plans counter-rallies in Telangana to defend the policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>J&amp;K cabinet developments:</strong> Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah met with LG Manoj Sinha ahead of a scheduled cabinet reshuffle, even as the BJP claims the ruling coalition faces internal instability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Administrative accountability:</strong> An RTI disclosure revealed that the Cabinet Secretary did not act on complaints filed by Election Commissioners because the communications were deemed unofficial.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>International parliamentary engagement:</strong> India is set to host the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi on October 26–27, while a European Parliament delegation will visit India to discuss the strategic agenda.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxQQjFFS09ZNEZBQ1VGcHhVSDNzdjMxNXBNLTJDWlNpaWhiQ2V0MWlpVzktWXdfLU9HU2FyU2RlczZ3M1VYRXRtWmhRZHVJVEZjNnREZGV4RV9OZmNKZjNLOVNyNWs3MzlUTkg4U2QteG5aSVZxa0hYMXNNYzBNVXFydjhxOXl3NEpkSmZwOGU3dG9QMFpnbUU3Y1RqaFliNGhCbzdkdm1tUUlzbHd4RzRBTTJIc0xBWWMxV2J0d01aUTE?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE5IeTY1c1U5Sy0wanVaTEJvNUZUdFd4N21UV2ZKbDVuZFdrcllWTHRYUGoyWlhySUljZkVSRC1VTUVkRG1IOUxIUUcxMFh0V2FRRTc5UVpucU8zcVdDa25ob2pTWlVrd0g1SG9qS1ZEd1k0M3ZK?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a></span></li>
